title: SDK Integration Corridor: streaming, structured outputs & function-calling sample ops
creator: Carmen Li
description: Coordinate cross-functional launch of the SDK surface enhancements that enable streaming responses, structured output primitives, and first-class function-calling helpers. Deliverables: (1) stabilized SDK APIs across JS/Python/Go for streaming + structured responses, (2) canonical sample kits that demonstrate function calling patterns and de-serialization of structured outputs, (3) docs + migration notes for customers moving from legacy SDKs, (4) release notes and GTM checklist for engineering, docs, DX, and marketing.
acceptance_criteria: SDKs (JS/Python/Go) expose the new streaming API parity with hosted endpoints documented in sdk-2026.04
Structured output schema helpers and validation utilities included in sample kits with README walkthroughs
Function-calling examples cover at least 3 real-world patterns (tool routing, multi-tool orchestration, and safe sandboxing) with tests
Docs PR merged to staging with sample snippets and copyedited migration guide
QA sign-off on end-to-end samples (CI green, manual smoke sessions completed), and telemetry events emitted for canary assess
Release notes drafted and approved by PM, Eng, and Legal; GTM checklist completed and assigned
updates: 2026-03-01: Kickoff with Eng, DX, and Docs. Agreed scope: streaming client helpers, structured-output serializers, three function-calling recipes. Assigned owners for SDKs: JS->Diego, Python->Maya Chen, Go->Alex Rivas.
2026-03-03: Eng spike completed: streaming proto stable; kernel routing dependency noted (ENG-72134). Blocker: TLS cert rotation affects long-lived streaming connections; Eng to patch.
2026-03-05: Docs PR created: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/SDKs/Streaming+and+Structured+Output (draft). Requested copy review from Content team; assigned editing slot for 2026-03-09.

2026-03-06: Sample repo initialized: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdks-sample-kits/pull/112 (bootstrap commit). Added streaming echo and function-calling toy example. Pending test harness and CI matrix for node/python/go.
2026-03-08: Design review with DX: decided on canonical JSON schema patterns for structured output (envelope with metadata/version). UX note: show best-effort vs strict parsing examples in samples.
2026-03-09: Legal requested clarification on third-party tool-call integrations; created legal Q&A doc and queued for expedited review (target 2026-03-12).

2026-03-10: Internal canary plan drafted: route 2% of internal traffic to new SDK client in staging-1; telemetry hooks defined (event keys: sdk.stream.start, sdk.stream.error, sdk.funcall.invoke). Eng owner: Priya Gopal.
qa_plan: Unit + integration tests for streaming clients across Node/Python/Go
End-to-end smoke using staging-1 with 2% canary traffic
Manual verification checklist for structured output parsing edge cases
Security review checklist for function-calling (tool ACLs, rate limits, output sanitization)
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: long-lived streaming connections may surface TLS rotation issues. Mitigation: Eng to add reconnection backoff and cert refresh handling (ENG-83412).
Risk: customers mis-parse structured output leading to silent errors. Mitigation: include strict schema examples and a compatibility shim in SDKs for legacy consumers.
Risk: function-calling could be used to exfiltrate sensitive data. Mitigation: gated examples, legal review, and recommended KMS/HSM patterns in docs.
next_steps: Finalize Docs PR and address copy edits by 2026-03-12
Complete sample kit CI matrix and add platform-specific README artifacts by 2026-03-14
Complete Legal security Q&A and obtain signoff by 2026-03-12
Run canary in staging-1 (2%) and collect telemetry from 2026-03-15 to 2026-03-18
Prepare release notes and GTM checklist for 2026-03-19 cross-functional review
